nodes.name: Decision request
nodes.notes: Called by the assessment flow when the update is a button press. The update travels as JSON, because a sub-workflow input is a typed field.

nodes.name: Decision pressed (test)
nodes.notes: Same payload shape as the chat trigger, so a button press can be exercised without touching the bot.

nodes.name: Settings D
nodes.notes: Everything an operator changes lives here. Spreadsheet id and chat id are the two that must.

nodes.name: Parse the button
nodes.notes: Reads the sample id out of the press so the row can be looked up before anything is decided.

nodes.name: Decision gate
nodes.notes: Idempotent by construction. A second press on the same card writes nothing and says who decided.

nodes.name: Clear the spinner
nodes.notes: Answered first. A button that spins for ten seconds gets pressed twice. An expired press must not block the write, so a failure here continues.

nodes.name: Build decision update
nodes.notes: The decider handle came off the callback sender in the gate, never off anything typed.

nodes.name: Record the decision
nodes.notes: The only write in the workflow that closes a sample.

nodes.name: Compose the stamp
nodes.notes: What the card becomes once it is settled.

nodes.name: Stamp the card
nodes.notes: Strips the buttons and states the outcome, so the chat history reads as a record rather than a menu.

nodes.name: Already decided
nodes.notes: A double tapped button is harmless and says so, rather than writing a second decision.

parameters.content:
## Flow D: Decision

The human gate. A press writes the decision, the handle of whoever pressed it, and a line in the log.

Pressing twice is harmless: the second press finds a decision already there and says who made it.

The decider name comes off the button press, never off anything typed.
